description: Source file implementing threading and locking functions for BoringSSL's crypto library, including callback setters and getters, and thread ID management.

methods.name: CRYPTO_num_locks
methods.description: Returns the number of locks, fixed at 1.

methods.name: CRYPTO_set_locking_callback
methods.description: Sets the callback function for locking.

methods.name: CRYPTO_set_add_lock_callback
methods.description: Sets the callback for atomic add-lock operations.

methods.name: CRYPTO_get_lock_name
methods.description: Returns a string indicating no old-style OpenSSL locks.

methods.name: CRYPTO_THREADID_set_callback
methods.description: Sets the callback for thread ID management.

methods.name: CRYPTO_THREADID_set_numeric
methods.description: Sets thread ID as a numeric value.

methods.name: CRYPTO_THREADID_set_pointer
methods.description: Sets thread ID as a pointer.

methods.name: CRYPTO_set_id_callback
methods.description: Sets the callback for obtaining thread IDs.

methods.name: CRYPTO_set_dynlock_create_callback
methods.description: Sets the callback for creating dynamic locks.

methods.name: CRYPTO_set_dynlock_lock_callback
methods.description: Sets the callback for locking/unlocking dynamic locks.

methods.name: CRYPTO_set_dynlock_destroy_callback
methods.description: Sets the callback for destroying dynamic locks.

methods.name: CRYPTO_get_dynlock_create_callback
methods.description: Gets the callback for creating dynamic locks.

methods.name: CRYPTO_get_dynlock_lock_callback
methods.description: Gets the callback for locking/unlocking dynamic locks.

methods.name: CRYPTO_get_dynlock_destroy_callback
methods.description: Gets the callback for destroying dynamic locks.
